GENERATE BURST K4v-gen-cast-b — Run C-3 P5 frost bolt VFX sheet 'cast_04_07' (the run_03 method; charter § 3 fork B). task_id "K4v-gen-cast-b".

One image_gen call: Generate a painted FROST CAST VFX animation sprite sheet, exactly 2 columns × 2 rows of equal square cells, four frames in row-major order. Reference image 1 is STYLE ONLY: match the icy blue-white energy at the character's staff tip, its faceted painted brushwork, hard illustrated edges and deep-blue falloff — do not include any character, hand, staff, scenery, symbols, text or grid. Pure uniform BLACK #000000 background, bright energy only (an additive emission plate). Every effect centred exactly in its own cell with generous black padding — no glow or particle touches a cell boundary. No photographic mist, neon laser style or fire-like flames. Frames 4–7 of 8 (the release and fade of the same flare): frame 4 the flare bursts outward, 44 %, shards flying outward; frame 5 the burst breaks into scattering shards with a shrinking core, 38 %; frame 6 faint fragments and a dim core, 24 %; frame 7 a few tiny fading sparks, 10 %, mostly black. Same effect, fading.

ONE retry only if the grid is wrong, a character/staff/text appears, or the background is not black — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/cast_04_07.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "K4v-gen-cast-b"; images = the file with prompt, references and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: STYLE ONLY — the frost energy at the staff tip
